meta.title: Approver approves the award proposal from the Approval Screen
gaps: Verify that this specific approver, rather than any approver, is shown as approved in the approval chain on the right
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that this specific approver, rather than any approver, is shown as approved in the approval chain on the right

steps.note: Open the submitted award proposal's approval screen.
Verify the approval note is available for review.
Verify the event overview control is present.
Verify the allocation details control is present.
Verify the approval-chain section is present.
Approve the submitted proposal as the pending approver.
Verify the proposal now displays an approval indication.
